integrity: The mathematical statements and evidence describe an original narrow claim subject to residual prior-art uncertainty; correctness is supported by symbolic proof and exact rational witnesses, not independent certification.
limitations: Uniform scalar attenuation, fixed nonnegative productive technical coefficients, unit final-demand shocks, equal gross-output weights. No welfare interpretation or endogenous substitution. Strictly positive witness establishes at least two changes without exact perturbed crossover values.
title: A sharp four-sector re-entrant optimum for Leontief gross-output multipliers
